Please note: Maximum 4 per boat. Has a weight capacity of 545 lbs so is best with a combination of children and adults. services.desc: About Save yourself the hassle of pulling your boat in and out of the water by mooring it on a buoy at the marina! We help you access your boat by towing your boat to the docks for you to load from or we will shuttle you out to your boat. When you have finished your ride, we will meet you out at a buoy to bring you back to the docks or you can pull up to the docks to park and we will tow your boat back to a buoy. faq.q: here can I stay up at Vallecito Lake?
faq.a: Vallecito Lake has plenty of accommodations for every budget. From Cabins and RV Parks to Forest Service Campgrounds and Vacation Homes, you’ll find the right place to stay. Where is the Marina? Vallecito Marina is located behind Pura Vida Cafe at 14772 County Road 501. Here is a Google Maps link. Do you rent Jet Skis? No, we don’t.
